narrative.overview: The system uses intersecting bands as a durable language for presence, encounter, and clear routes. Large typographic statements sit beside constructed abstract fields rather than stock religious imagery. The overall tone is contemporary and institutional, with calm reading surfaces punctuated by decisive color.
keyCharacteristics: High-contrast indigo and cobalt fields balanced by cool mineral white.
Coral and marigold bands used as structural intersections.
Oversized, tightly set Bricolage Grotesque headlines.
Mostly square geometry with one clipped upper-right notch.
Explicit status language for pending or unconfirmed information.

rules.name: The Field Rule
rules.body: Color owns complete regions or intersecting bands; it is not sprinkled as disconnected decoration.

rules.name: The Truth-State Rule
rules.body: Pending information is signaled with coral outlined squares and plain language, never hidden in low-contrast fine print.

rules.name: The Short-Line Rule
rules.body: Display copy stays compact and balanced; body copy carries explanation at a calmer measure.

dos: Do use full color fields and deliberate overlap to create hierarchy.
Do preserve cool pale grounds, strong contrast, and visible keyboard focus.
Do use the clipped notch sparingly on primary actions or explicit status planes.
Do keep unconfirmed institutional details visibly marked as pending.
donts: Don't present the three-bar brand treatment as an approved church logo.
Don't add stock church imagery, ornamental stained-glass effects, gradients, or decorative religious symbols without approved assets.
Don't turn content into rows of interchangeable rounded cards.
Don't reduce labels or interactive copy below the established legibility floor.
